name: Book PDF
description: Prints an entire Book to a PDF.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Installation 
 wkhtmltopdf is used to generate the PDF document so this will need to be installed on your system before you can use this module. 

 Once the wkhtmltopdf binary is installed then you should use Composer to install the Drupal module and it's PHP dependencies: composer require drupal/book_pdf 

 Back to top 

 Usage 
 Once the module is installed and enabled you will find a 'Book PDF: link' block which can be used to present the user with a link to download a Book as PDF when placed on a Book page.
